$comment: Pinned local model manifest. ARCHITECTURE.md Section 8 requires model versions
to be pinned and shipped with the extension rather than fetched at runtime, so
the demo cannot break because someone else's host went down or changed a file.
The sha256 values are checked by tools/verify-models.mjs on every build. Shapes
were read out of the ONNX graph itself, not copied from a README.

models.name: UltraFace version-RFB-320 (simplified)
notes: Exported from PyTorch 1.2, which lists every initializer in graph.input.
session.inputNames therefore returns ~100 names; only 'input' is a real feed
and the rest resolve from initializers. Do not iterate inputNames to build
scores[...,1] is the face-class probability; scores[...,0] is background.
boxes are NOT decoded rectangles. The output is SSD-style regression offsets
relative to a fixed prior grid; the measured raw range on a real page was
-4.268..3.368. Decode with src/offscreen/priors.ts before use. The reference
implementation's docs describe normalised 0..1 corners, which is true of some
exports of this model and false of this file. An earlier note here repeated
that claim on faith and cost a day's worth of wrong face coordinates.
The count is asserted at runtime against the model's output shape: a mismatch
means every box would be decoded against the wrong anchor, which produces
confident detections in wrong places rather than an error.
